purpose: Define the one bounded, governed acquisition and final-lock process required to provide valid D1 ABSENT evidence for the M-PV3.8 final selection membership.

eligible_absent_definition.meaning: A SafeNest non-clinical breathing-reference state, not clinical apnea and not an inference from radar amplitude, model output, missing data, presence, or quality failure.
eligible_absent_definition.target_interval_rule: The complete five-second physiology target interval must be contained within the same authoritative reference ABSENT interval. Any onset, offset, disagreement, incomplete coverage, or uncertain alignment is AMBIGUOUS, never ABSENT.

recording_separation_rules: Each ABSENT recording ID must be distinct from every candidate-training recording ID.
Each ABSENT recording ID must be distinct from every final-membership PRESENT recording ID for that subject.
Selected 30-second input contexts must not overlap another selected final-membership input context.
No selected target interval may be reused.
A recording that fails provenance or quality qualification is rejected rather than replaced after the campaign closes.
bounded_acquisition_campaign.campaign_stop: The campaign stops when exactly 19 eligible ABSENT contexts have been accepted for each held-out subject, or when the three predeclared ABSENT recordings for any subject have been exhausted. No additional recording, subject, source, or collection round is authorized by this contract.

quality_and_reference_requirements.failure_rule: Any quality, timing, reference, or reviewer disagreement fails closed: retain the row in the exception or ambiguity registry and do not count it as eligible ABSENT.

final_membership_lock.label_mapping_rule: The manifest must map the immutable raw reference label to BREATHING_REFERENCE_ABSENT with an explicit mapping ID, version, checksum, and evidence. A mapping cannot be inferred or revised after membership lock.
final_membership_lock.ambiguity_registry_rule: Every rejected, uncertain, transition, incomplete, or disagreement row is recorded with its original label/reference evidence, reason code, and exclusion decision. AMBIGUOUS is retained and never converted to PRESENT or ABSENT.
final_membership_lock.lock_rule: Lock all membership rows, provenance fields, label mapping, ambiguity registry, subject/class counts, and checksums before any candidate output is opened. The lock is immutable for M-PV3.8 selection.

minimum_acceptable_membership.recording_diversity: Three distinct qualifying ABSENT recordings per subject, with the fixed 7/6/6 context allocation.
minimum_acceptable_membership.training_disjointness: All final-membership subjects, recordings, and windows are disjoint from candidate training.
minimum_acceptable_membership.acceptance_statement: This is the complete minimum for proceeding to the already-defined M-PV3.8 final selection evaluation. It is not a model-selection result by itself.

terminal_decisions.membership_ready: When all 57 PRESENT and all 57 governed ABSENT rows satisfy the final lock, M-PV3.8 final selection evaluation may proceed once under its existing contract.
terminal_decisions.membership_blocked: If any count, subject, recording separation, provenance, label mapping, ambiguity, checksum, or quality rule fails, final selection remains BLOCKED_INVALID_FINAL_MEMBERSHIP and no candidate output is opened.
terminal_decisions.direction_reconsideration_required: If the one bounded campaign closes without the complete valid membership, or if an authoritative non-D2/non-MR60 ABSENT reference cannot be established, stop collection and mark ROLE_L_FULL_TASK selection direction RECONSIDERATION_REQUIRED. This contract authorizes no additional collection loop.
